purpose: Records the current code would decide differently from their committed form and that need the models to be decided: the RAG step, replayed offline on the committed caches, now reports a figure or reaches the page-vision step, and the committed record was written without it. Until each is extracted again it keeps its committed form; scripts/restate_record_status.py leaves these records alone, and the corpus replay check reads this list as its declared exceptions. Since 3 October 2026 (stage 2 of the fix cycle for the review of 2 October 2026) it also lists the 16 records whose stored table triangle the report-year diagonal rule refuses and that the offline replay cannot serve: 13 stop at a page-vision step that has no cached response, and 3 would be written as no deterministic reading and leave the working sample. Each keeps its committed form until a page-vision call is authorised, or its page is read and its figure registered.

extracted.note: the 13 records extracted again one at a time with the models (prompt 2.13, --batch, Azure cache only, no table-backend call); each was read against its filing page afterwards. The $0.2732 (the sum of the records' total_cost_usd) is the price of the run's 24 whole-document calls only: it leaves out the Gemini thinking tokens those calls recorded and the run's page-vision calls (8 cached responses), whose cost was not recorded (see cost).

cost.counts: the 24 whole-document calls, gemini-2.5-flash and gpt-5-mini for each of the 12 records that reached the models (1985/2024 became a first-year stub before them): the sum of those records' total_cost_usd, each the sum of its two responses' cost_usd, which test_gemini prices from PRICING and the input and output token counts the response recorded. It is the price table's figure, not a provider's bill.
cost.gemini_tokens_not_priced_note: the 12 gemini-2.5-flash whole-document responses record 76,473 tokens in total_tokens beyond their input and output counts (the model's thinking tokens); the price formula prices the input and output counts only, so these tokens are not in the $0.2732. The gpt-5-mini responses record no such difference.
cost.page_vision_note: the run's page-image calls to gemini-2.5-flash, known from their responses: the 8 page-level llm_cache entries written for these records on 2026-09-29 (pages numbered from 1). A response that fails to parse is not cached, so a call retried after one would not show here. The page-level cache keeps the triangle only, not the token usage, and the page-vision cost reaches neither a record's total_cost_usd nor the run total, so the cost of these calls was not recorded. 1985/2024 made no whole-document call, and its stub records no cost.
